messages:
zoe: heads-up: prepping Friday KPI review. launch social posts drove +24% traffic but dashboard routed leads down 18%. anyone see a recent pipeline change?

ben: Which tile? weekly -> acquisition_overview?

zoe: yes, filter=launch-spring, last_7_days. impressions/CTR look healthy. routed_leads is the odd one.

metrics-bot: nightly ETL finished at 06:05 UTC. looker.dashboard.acquisition_overview refreshed.

maya: quick check: our routing ETL started writing a new field campaign_variant this week; Looker join still uses campaign_key. ~130 rows are landing in unknown because campaign_key is null.

priya: that explains some. plus I noticed gclid-only registrations in GA that never get mapped to a channel because our click-decoder runs after sessionization.

ben: can we do a one-off warehouse backfill to populate campaign_key from campaign_variant for last 10 days? small SQL should fix counts for the KPI deck.

maya: yes, scheduling backfill now. also adding a card to the KPI dashboard: "source concordance" with breakdown: schema-change, gclid-only, dedupe mismatch.

metrics-bot: backfill job scheduled by maya 5% job_id bf-365987-01; estimate 20m

ad-ops: FYI if ~130 get reassigned to paid, reported paid CPA will change. please include CPA delta in the notes.

priya: quick numbers from GA: 1,260 regs (event: webinar_reg) vs Looker 1,190 vs CRM 1,005. backfill + dedupe adjustments should bring Looker closer to GA but expect residual variance due to dedupe rules.

zoe: OK. action items before Friday: (1) maya run backfill and post job id/result, (2) ben add "source concordance" card to KPI board with counts, (3) priya estimate CPA delta if paid attribution changes, (4) include 2-line explainer about cookie-vs-email dedupe.

maya: backfill completed 5% job_id bf-365987-01; 122 rows updated, 8 rows excluded (no email).

ben: added KPI card: concordance counts -> schema-change:130, gclid-only:155, dedupe-delta:48. attached short note.

priya: estimated paid CPA impact +9% if all gclid-only map to paid. ad-ops will review before the weekly.

zoe: great work. we'll show transparency on Friday: numbers, root causes, and next steps (landing script fix, move click-decoder earlier, and add schema-gating to ETL).
